summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary Robotic Assistance Devices secured an order for seven ROSA security units from a new municipal customer in a major Midwest city. The order, facilitated by a longstanding channel partner, expands RAD's municipal security presence; units will be deployed throughout a civic plaza, with city council approval and funding. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or closing date were disclosed. This is a routine commercial order announcement, not a special situation. Watch for revenue contribution and municipal pipeline growth.
